summary: Iter6 full backend + frontend admin-panel verification. 13/13 backend admin endpoint tests passed (1 skipped due to seed data: no visible review). All 7 admin tabs render with correct data-testids, full UI flows (verify/unverify, ban/unban, soft-cancel job, retry invoice, fee min-€4 guard, CSV export) work end-to-end. Header search is GONE for both homeowner and pro accounts. Language switch translates all 7 tab labels + stat cards + chart labels to German.

issues: Two stacked top bars are visible on /admin: the global app Header (with EN/bell/Admin chip) and immediately below it the new sticky admin-header (Hammer + ServiceMarket + ADMIN badge + Shield + Admin chip). Visually redundant — the user-chip and the language switcher appear twice. Spec mentions only the new admin sticky header; consider hiding the global Header for /admin/* routes or removing the duplicate user chip from one of them.

Activity feed event titles (e.g., "Veber submitted ID verification") remain hard-coded English from backend even after switching to DE. Not in test scope but worth i18n on the server side or translation in the activity item renderer.

action_items: (optional/design) Hide the global Header on /admin or drop the duplicate language switcher/user chip to avoid the stacked-header look.
(optional/i18n) Translate Recent Activity event titles server-side (or in the renderer) so they switch with DE/FR/IT.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_routes.py /admin/recent-activity merges 4 sources well, but the verification events use pro_profile.created_at as a proxy — this means an already-verified pro keeps appearing as a 'submitted verification' event. Consider switching to verified_at or a dedicated verification_events collection.

Categories endpoint returns raw Mongo docs (cats = await db.categories.find().to_list(20)) — `_id` is a string like 'plumbing' here, so it works, but inconsistent with other endpoints that go through serialize_doc(). Worth normalising for parity.
_invoice_rows() runs N+1 user lookups (one per transaction). Fine at 9 rows today; will get slow at scale. Recommend $lookup aggregation or batched user fetch.

Billing tab uses data-testid=billing-stat-mrr/subs/fees/failed (NOT pro-subs/contact-rev as in the request spec) — the four cards do exist, just under different testids. window.confirm and window.alert auto-accept is required for Jobs/Reviews/Users destructive flows; use page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()).
